name: bigquery-slot-cost-optimizer
description: >- Analyzes Google Cloud BigQuery slot consumption, query costs, and execution bottlenecks using INFORMATION_SCHEMA. Use when diagnosing slow BigQuery queries, slot starvation, high on-demand query costs, unpartitioned table scans, or join performance issues. Don't use for generic BigQuery administration (use bigquery-basics), BigQuery ML (use bigquery-ai-ml), or DataFrame operations (use bigquery-bigframes).
author: google
